statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The condition is coded as I48.91
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically indicated to accurately correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Continuous rhythm assessment is necessary to optimize rate control management
